obligations.title: Hold a weekly steering committee meeting.
Circulate agendas in advance and minutes and action logs after each governance meeting.
Report on Milestone progress, risks, issues and change requests at governance meetings.
Deliver mobilisation report, delivery plan, resourcing and governance plan by 22 November 2025.
Deliver solution architecture, integration and data migration designs, and test strategy by 02 March 2026.
Deliver tested Wave 1 solution, cutover report and hypercare plan by 08 September 2026.
Deliver tested Wave 2 solution, operational documentation, handover and training materials by 05 February 2027.
Notify Customer in writing of likely Milestone miss, with cause and recovery plan.
Notify Customer in writing on completing a Deliverable or Milestone and submit evidence.
Appoint a programme sponsor and a business lead.
Appoint a programme manager with day-to-day authority.
Accept or reject submitted Deliverables within a reasonable period, giving reasons if rejected.
Notify Customer promptly if an assumption proves incorrect.
Notify Customer without undue delay of any personal data breach.
Apply appropriate technical and organisational security measures to personal data.
Return or delete Customer personal data on completion of the Services.
On termination or expiry, deliver Deliverables, return Customer materials and data, and provide transition assistance.
